# Success only when status is 1

`M3` · Coding rule

Requests are FormData; pass { navigation } as the 3rd argument; success only when data?.status == 1, else show data.message and set the empty/error state

Defined in [[brain/context/conventions-mobile|Mobile app coding rules]].
